page_title: RAY 1-1 VAL | Rayo Vallecano v Valencia 19/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' A pass from Isi Palazon gives Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) a shooting opportunity on the edge of the box, but the effort is poor and goes well wide of the right post.
90+3' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90+2' Rafa Mir (Valencia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The referee is firm and issues Umar Sadiq (Valencia) a deserved yellow card. Umar Sadiq (Valencia) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
89' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.

88' Rafa Mir (Valencia) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Augusto Batalla!
86' Fran Perez (Valencia) sends a cross in and finds Umar Sadiq inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
85' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
83' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Oscar Valentin will be replaced by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano).
83' Substitution. Randy Nteka leaves the pitch and is replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano).
83' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is repeatedly being caught offside.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Alejandro Quintero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Pepelu (Valencia) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

80' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Valencia.
79' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) gets the ball from a rebound before trying his luck with a good long-range shot which threatens the goalkeeper! The ball sails painfully wide of the right post!
79' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
79' The ball is cleared after Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Rayo Vallecano can continue in their attacking effort.
77' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is out of play. Valencia will take a throw-in.
75' 1 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Umar Sadiq (Valencia) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:1.
75' What an opportunity! Umar Sadiq (Valencia) blasts a first-time shot from inside the box that rattles the right post.
74' Problems for Carlos Corberan as Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Pepelu replaces him.
74' The game is interrupted now, Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
73' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for an infringement.
71' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Jorge de Frutos.
71' Here comes a substitution. Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is brought on as a substitute for Gerard Gumbau.
70' Rafa Mir (Valencia) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just inches over the bar.
69' The total number of attempts is 6:6. 4:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
66' Carlos Corberan prepares a substitution. Jose Gaya is replaced by Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).
66' That will be all from Andre Almeida who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Umar Sadiq (Valencia).

64' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a comfortable save.
63' Jose Gaya (Valencia) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar.
62' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
61' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Rayo Vallecano force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
60' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
59' The attendance for today's match is 11308.
58' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Giorgi Mamardashvili.
58' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Rayo Vallecano.
56' A lofted cross from Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
55' Carlos Corberan has decided to make a change. Rafa Mir (Valencia) replaces Hugo Duro.
55' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fran Perez (Valencia) is coming onto the pitch as Luis Rioja cannot continue after picking up an injury.
54' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
52' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
52' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
51' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
51' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Rayo Vallecano will take a corner.
50' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) tries to find Jorge de Frutos, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
49' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
46' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.

46' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45' 1 - 0 Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it inside the left post of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
44' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
42' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
40' Jose Gaya (Valencia) picks out Luis Rioja with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
39' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
37' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Randy Nteka, but Giorgi Mamardashvili displays great awareness to stop him.
37' 8:3 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
37' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) tackles a bit over-zealously and Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
35' The corner from Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared away by the defence.
34' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano). The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
32' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
32' Two players stand over the free kick. Javi Guerra (Valencia) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
30' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) trips an opposition player and Alejandro Quintero signals a foul. Valencia are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
29' Jose Gaya (Valencia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' Andre Almeida (Valencia) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
28' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
25' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) rises high on the edge of the box to meet a cross and plants a powerful header goalwards, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is alert and makes a decent save to deny him.
24' 0:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:1.
21' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul and Alejandro Quintero immediately signals a free kick.

20' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom left corner. Augusto Batalla shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
20' Andre Almeida (Valencia) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
20' Andre Almeida (Valencia) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Valencia are going to take it.
19' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Valencia.
16' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
15' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
14' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) sends a long ball forward to Alvaro Garcia, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The linesman signals a throw-in for Valencia.
13' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
12' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
10' Alejandro Quintero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jose Gaya (Valencia) and blew his whistle.
7' Diego Lopez slides a brilliant pass into Hugo Duro (Valencia), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
6' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Diego Lopez (Valencia), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
5' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends a long ball forward to Hugo Duro, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is behind the touchline and Rayo Vallecano will take a throw-in.
5' Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Andrei Ratiu with a fine lofted pass.
3' Hugo Duro (Valencia) climbs highest in the middle of the box after a cross from the wing, but sends a good looking header narrowly wide of the left post.
2' A crossfield pass from Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates.
